lens: naming (kebab-case BNF, content-type clarity, milestone-id consistency, justification-table presence)
summary: Flat basenames are BNF-compliant kebab-case with semantic content-type clarity. ADR-0119 carries a 35-row naming-justification table covering every hoisted path. Two milestone-id naming issues remain: duplicate M02 prefix and questionable M03-first-tenant ordering vs A3's duplicate-id finding.

findings.claim: Flat specs basenames are kebab-case + content-type clear
findings.evidence: All 33 hoisted files (e.g. `specs/forbidden-operations.json`, `specs/decision-principles.json`, `specs/lifecycle-configs/adr-status-lifecycle.json`) use lowercase-kebab + `.json` suffix; basenames carry the noun-phrase semantic without abbreviation. Confirmed via `git ls-tree -r origin/dev specs/`.

findings.claim: ADR-0119 carries the required naming-justification table
findings.evidence: ADR-0119 `## Naming justification` section enumerates 35 rows: `specs/`, `specs/lifecycle-configs/`, the ADR filename itself, plus one row per hoisted spec file with a one-line BNF-conformance justification each. Matches F2's count.

findings.claim: Duplicate M02 milestone prefix violates milestone-id uniqueness
findings.evidence: Diff touches both `.omc/plans/milestones/M02-substrate/INDEX.md` and `.omc/plans/milestones/M02-foundry-preview/phases/...` (e.g. lines 287 + 407 in pr-18.diff). `ls .omc/plans/milestones/` confirms both `M02-substrate/` and `M02-foundry-preview/` coexist. A milestone id should map 1:1 to a name; two `M02-*` directories make the id ambiguous. A3 flagged the same duplicate.
findings.why: Agents resolving 'M02' from registries/specs cannot deterministically pick a milestone. Breaks ADR-0115 flat-canonical naming spirit.
findings.fix: Renumber one branch (e.g. promote `M02-foundry-preview` to `M03-foundry-preview` and cascade subsequent M0x) OR collapse into a single `M02-foundry-preview-substrate`. Document in a follow-up ADR; not blocking this PR but blocking next merge through that area.

findings.claim: `M03-first-tenant` ordering vs `M03-cloud-saas-search-workspace-preview` is also a duplicate-prefix
findings.evidence: `ls .omc/plans/milestones/` shows `M03-cloud-saas-search-workspace-preview/` AND `M03-first-tenant/` (diff lines 413, 422). Same duplicate-id pattern as M02.
findings.fix: Renumber `M03-first-tenant` to `M04-first-tenant` (and cascade) once M02/M03 sequencing ADR lands. Naming itself (`first-tenant` kebab) is fine.

findings.claim: ADR-0119 prose uses inconsistent referent for the retired directory
findings.evidence: ADR-0119 alternates between `'cross-cutting/'` (literal, in Context) and `'former nested spec scope directory'` (paraphrase, throughout Decision/Migration). Both refer to the same path. The flat path itself is fine; prose consistency is a style nit.
findings.fix: Pick one referent (recommend the literal `specs/cross-cutting/`) for unambiguous grep-ability.

whats_missing: No explicit naming rule in ADR-0119 prohibiting future `specs/<scope>/<concept>.json` patterns aside from `lifecycle-configs/`. A one-line rule would lock in the flat-default and prevent re-sprawl.

No back-compat alias entry; ADR-0115 sibling pattern usually records `migrated_to` for old paths. ADR-0119 only says 'rewrite references' which leaves external agents with cached old paths to fail silently.

ambiguity_risks.quote: Future cross-cutting machine-readable specs are added at `specs/<concept>.json` unless they belong to an existing typed family such as `specs/lifecycle-configs/`.
ambiguity_risks.interpretation_a: Only the existing `lifecycle-configs/` family is allowed; new families need a new ADR.
ambiguity_risks.interpretation_b: Any typed family is allowed; lifecycle-configs is merely an example.
ambiguity_risks.risk: Reviewers may approve sprawl under interpretation B; ADR-0115 spirit favours A.

multi_perspective.executor: Clear: every hoisted path has a one-line justification, so a future contributor placing a new spec knows the rule.
multi_perspective.skeptic: Two milestone-prefix duplicates undermine the 'one canonical name' claim; the spec topology is clean but the planning topology regressed.

verdict_justification: ADR-0119 is naming-correct, BNF-compliant, and content-type-clear; the justification table is comprehensive. The duplicate M02/M03 milestone prefixes (A3-corroborated) are real but live in a different file family from the spec hoist, so they don't block this PR — they block the next planning edit. Hence ACCEPT-WITH-RESERVATIONS rather than REVISE.
open_questions: Should `lifecycle-configs/` itself eventually flatten to `specs/<name>-lifecycle.json` for full ADR-0115 parity, or is the typed-family directory the new pattern for any future N-of-a-kind set?
